passages.title: School Trip to France
passages.text: Hello everyone. I am here to give you the final details about our upcoming school trip to France. We will be departing from the school gates at 7:30 am on Monday morning, so please make sure you arrive on time. We are staying at a lovely hotel in the countryside, which is famous for its large swimming pool. On the first day, we will visit a local museum to learn about history. The most exciting part of the trip will be the visit to the chocolate factory on Wednesday, where we can taste everything! For lunch, we will have a picnic in the park, but please remember to bring a bottle of water. Finally, don't forget to bring your camera to take photos of the beautiful scenery. I am sure we will have a fantastic time!
